Welcome to Life of a Rural Veterinarian.

I am a veterinarian working with farm animals in rural areas. On this channel you will see real veterinary work, animal treatments, farm visits, and interesting cases with cows, sheep, goats and poultry.

Learn about animal health, farm life and veterinary medicine.

Subscribe to see the real life of a rural vet.
